events.title: Next Fest!
events.summary: Alea is free to play as part of Steam Next Fest, starting now through October 26. No signup required. Just download the demo from the main Steam page. See you in the arena.

events.title: Open Playtest!
events.summary: ALEA is live for testing! This test will run through October 13th. No sign-up required. Just download the demo from the Steam page.Queue up for 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 matches and find your new main from our diverse set of heroes. You can leave feedback and report bugs in game. And if you crash, PLEASE press "Send" on the crash report!See you in the arena.

events.title: Demo, Balance, & Stamina
events.summary: The demo is live! There's even some yet-unannounced content in there. For now, I’ll cover two big changes: balance and stamina.STAMINAStamina has been significantly changed. Here’s a summary: - Dodges are buffed. You travel faster, go further, and carry momentum - Dodges now fall into 3 tiers: fast, medium, and slow. events.title: PvP Fest -> (June) NextFest
events.summary: PvP FestPvP Fest is over, and I am happy with the results. Thanks to everyone who downloaded & played. We got some wishlists, a bunch of new players, and reliably kept the servers online. The reception was very positive.NextFestWhile I originally planned on rolling straight into NextFest in February, I've decided instead to push Alea to the June NextFest. These extra few months will give me time to finish some crucial features and new content, as well as market the game more. Updates & PlayTests
